_about: 人间功课 as cultivation (Hanli, 2026-10-22: 「游戏里还要有和其他app如cfo, shifu, health等互动」 → 「可以」). Each app's quest file names a chore's `kind` — a plain word of its own, never a game word; this table, keyed by that kind, is what the chore means in the book: its in-world name (`name`, the 人间功课 board's label), the facts handed to 银月 when it is handed in (`about`: never shown, she words it), and what it adds on top of the chore's own pay (rules/chores.mjs choreGrant): `wealth` 灵石 and `progress` 修为 off the `chore_kind` table (balance.json pay), and an `item` (items.json — chore-only things, small effects declared there). A `week` row pays once a week when chores of the kind were handed in on `days` different days of it (the `chore_week` table) — 宗门月俸. `per_day` caps what the meanings add in one local day, all kinds together (`items`: how many things). The rules name no app and no chore id (rules/gongke.mjs); a chore with no kind, or a kind not here, pays as before and means nothing more. 开府's one-time milestones never take a meaning. Never needed for the main line; paid once per chore occurrence (the chore's own period).

about.zh: 小满在山道上挑着担子练脚力，一趟一趟往上爬——功夫是腿上磨出来的。
about.en: Xiaoman climbs the mountain path under the yoke, trip after trip — the practice is worn into the legs.

about.zh: 一夜好睡，神养足了，闭关时心定得快。
about.en: A good night's sleep; the spirit is full, and in seclusion the mind settles sooner.

about.zh: 问过医、看过脉案，身上哪里不顺，心里有了数。
about.en: The healer's word read, the pulse notes looked over: what is off in the body is known now.

about.zh: 小满娘的话：「遇事先算账。」账算清了，灵石才攒得住。
about.en: Xiaoman's mother's word: "Before anything, do the accounts." Kept straight, the spirit stones stay.

about.zh: 洞府洒扫一遍，丹炉清了灰——下一炉成色高一等。
about.en: The abode swept, the furnace cleared of ash — the next pot comes out a grade better.

about.zh: 护山大阵查过一遍、补了一角——藏珍有了着落，山门稳了。
about.en: The mountain's great ward walked and one corner mended — the treasures are kept, the gate holds.

about.zh: 听了一曲、唱了一段，心里松快。
about.en: A song heard, a verse sung; the heart eases.
